changelog:
- Initial release of model-usage-linux.
- Track OpenClaw AI token usage and cost per model by parsing Linux session JSONL files.
- Provides per-model breakdown: turns, input/output tokens, cache usage, and cost in USD.
- Includes CLI options for output format and custom session directory.
- Designed as a Linux replacement for the macOS-only model-usage/CodexBar skill.
